name: stream_whales
plain: Net position of ~60 profitable HL accounts per coin: coins.<SYM> = [net, gross, n_long, n_short].

invariants.expr: all(abs(v[0]) <= v[1] for v in g('coins').values())
all(v[0] <= 0 for v in g('coins').values() if v[2] == 0)
all(v[0] >= 0 for v in g('coins').values() if v[3] == 0)

expected_fields_note: Baseline = union of fields in the last 20 rows at seed time. D10 flags any field that disappears. The source API's own field set is not captured yet.
